anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a wide radius extending from the blowhole region toward the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick beak with a low pixel length-to-width ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow, obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the melon curvature meets the rostrum ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent, darkly pigmented pectoral fin with a tapered apex and recurved trailing edge.
